title: HDFC Large Cap Fund — Scheme Information Document (21 November 2025)
text: The HDFC Large Cap Fund Scheme Information Document describes an open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in large-cap stocks. Its investment objective is to provide long-term capital appreciation or income by investing predominantly in large-cap companies; the objective is not guaranteed. The minimum application amount or switch-in is Rs. 100 and any amount thereafter.

title: HDFC Large Cap Fund — Key Information Memorandum (21 November 2025)
text: The HDFC Large Cap Fund Key Information Memorandum describes an open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in large-cap stocks. Its indicative asset allocation to equity and equity-related instruments of large-cap companies is 80% to 100% of total assets. These are the stated scheme allocation limits, not a current portfolio holding or return.

title: HDFC Flexi Cap Fund — Scheme Information Document (21 November 2025)
text: The HDFC Flexi Cap Fund Scheme Information Document describes an open-ended dynamic equity scheme investing across large-cap, mid-cap and small-cap stocks. Its investment objective is to generate capital appreciation or income from a portfolio predominantly invested in equity and equity-related instruments; the objective is not guaranteed. The minimum application amount or switch-in is Rs. 100 and any amount thereafter.

title: HDFC Flexi Cap Fund — Key Information Memorandum (21 November 2025)
text: The HDFC Flexi Cap Fund Key Information Memorandum describes an open-ended dynamic equity scheme investing across large-cap, mid-cap and small-cap stocks. Its indicative asset allocation to equity and equity-related instruments is 65% to 100% of total assets. These are scheme allocation limits, not a current portfolio holding or return.

title: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund — Scheme Information Document (21 November 2025)
text: The HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Scheme Information Document states an investment objective of generating capital appreciation or income from a portfolio predominantly comprising equity and equity-related instruments; the objective is not guaranteed. It lists a minimum application amount or switch-in of Rs. 500 and in multiples of Rs. 500 thereafter. This is the application minimum, not a claim about SIP frequency.

title: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund — Key Information Memorandum (21 November 2025)
text: The HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Key Information Memorandum gives an indicative asset allocation of 80% to 100% of total assets to equity and equity-related instruments. These are the scheme allocation limits, not a current portfolio holding or return.

The minimum application amount or switch-in is Rs. 100 and any amount thereafter.

title: HDFC Small Cap Fund — Key Information Memorandum (21 November 2025)
text: The HDFC Small Cap Fund Key Information Memorandum gives an indicative asset allocation of 65% to 100% of total assets to equity and equity-related instruments of small-cap companies. These are the scheme allocation limits, not a current portfolio holding or return.

title: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund — Scheme Information Document (21 November 2025)
text: The HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund Scheme Information Document describes an open-ended Balanced Advantage Fund. Its investment objective is to provide long-term capital appreciation or income from a dynamic mix of equity and debt investments; the objective is not guaranteed. The minimum application amount or switch-in is Rs. 100 and any amount thereafter.

title: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund — Key Information Memorandum (21 November 2025)
text: The HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund Key Information Memorandum describes an open-ended Balanced Advantage Fund with a stated objective of providing long-term capital appreciation or income from a dynamic mix of equity and debt investments. Its stated benchmark is the NIFTY 50 Hybrid Composite Debt 50:50 Index (TRI). A benchmark is not a performance claim.
